Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

6. Promotion during the year.On regular promotion of a member to a higher Group after the 1st January in any year, his subscription will be raised only from the 1st January of the next year. As for example, a Group 'C' employee is promoted to Group 'B' on 2-1-2021. His subscription and Insurance Cover will be ~ 30 p.m. and ~ 30,000 till the end of December, 2021 and will be raised to ~ 60 p.m. and ~ 60,000 respectively from January, 2022.
